subject: Vendor portal seller setup — MSA redlines & PO field constraints
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsys.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Cc: procurement_team@medsys.com
Date: 2025-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portal onboarding: MSA / PO field constraints for MedSys

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the intro to Redwood's onboarding team. We're ready to start seller provisioning in Ariba but have a couple of required contract/PO items to align on before we can complete vendor registration:

- Our procurement needs an MSA that explicitly keeps data residency and audit logs in our account; any cross-tenant telemetry requires written consent.
- PO fields: our ERP requires two custom PO fields (PO Type Code + ClinDept) and a stable invoice remit address (we can't accept an email remit).
- We have a mandatory SOC 2 evidence packet request and a copy of a negotiated MSA redline from our legal team — we'd like Redwood to comment on a few clauses (indemnity, liability cap, and termination for convenience).

I've attached the MedSys redline (PDF) and can export our required PO mapping as an XLSX if helpful. Can you confirm what your standard playbook is for portal onboarding when the buyer requests redline review before registration?

Best,
Asha Patel
Director, Vendor Enablement
MedSys Health
Procurement: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MedSys_MSA_redline_v3.pdf
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2025-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: MSA / PO field constraints for MedSys

Hi Asha — thanks for the details and the redline. Quick take: we can support custom PO fields in the Ariba connector and set a remit address field (we generally write the remit to a legal address block). For the MSA redline, I’ve looped in Marissa (legal) and Kim (integration/ops) so they can weigh in on the specific clauses.

Operationally, two notes:
1) We typically scope registration as a two-step process — vendor activation in the portal (fields + credentials) and acceptance of the orderflow (PO/EDI mapping) after commercial/Legal signoff. If you need registration gated on redline acceptance, we can put the activation on hold and run a parallel redline review.
2) If you need a temporary workaround to accept POs while legal discussions proceed, we can enable manual PO validation for the first 30 days (limited volume).

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to confirm which redline items are material and propose language.
- Kim to confirm field mapping and whether RWD needs any changes to our order-processing schema.
- Schedule a 30-minute call this week to go through the redline and PO field spreadsheet.

Are you available Thursday 5/22 or Friday 5/23 afternoon PST?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Fri, May 16, 2025 at 11:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Quick take: we can support custom PO fields in the Ariba connector...

Hi Asha — thanks for sending the redline. I reviewed MedSys_MSA_redline_v3.pdf and flagged three items we need to push back on:

1) Indemnity expansion: the redline inserts a third-party IP indemnity carve-in that is broader than our standard. We can accept a narrower IP carve-out limited to infringing outputs attributable to Redwood-hosted models, but not general third-party supply chain carve-ins.

2) Unlimited termination for convenience notice: your redline shortens notice to 10 days. We can accept 30 days with pro-rata refund for committed Dedicated capacity only; hosted API customers remain on standard 30-day notice.

3) Data residency/audit telemetry: we can commit to customer-controlled audit logs and a private telemetry option for Private deployments, but hosted telemetry contains anonymized performance metrics. We can add a contractual clause describing the private telemetry option and obligations for data access.

I’m attaching our suggested redline snippets as comments — call them "Marissa_edits_MedSys_v1.pdf" (I can also export the snippets as tracked changes if you prefer). From a procurement gating perspective, we require that indemnity and termination be closed before full automated onboarding is turned on (we can keep manual PO validation enabled until contract is signed).

Proposed call times: Thur 5/22 1:00–3:00pm PST or Fri 5/23 9:30–11:00am PST. Rishi / Kim — please confirm if those windows work for ops.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Hi Asha —

Thanks, Marissa — that matches our expectations. Asha, I’ll leave the legal points to Marissa, but operationally Kim and Mateo confirmed we can map the two custom fields (PO Type Code + ClinDept) into the Ariba payload and persist the remit address to the "billTo/remitAddress" block in our schema. We’ve prepared a template for the PO field mapping (attached) and a short runbook for enabling manual PO validation during the contract window.

I added a tentative DocuSign envelope for the order form (link below) so procurement can begin populating commercial terms while legal finishes the MSA. If we agree to the 30-day termination notice and the narrower IP carve-out Marissa proposed, we can flip the onboarding switch the day the MSA is signed.

Meeting: Thu 2025-05-22 13:30–14:00 PST (30 min) — I've sent a calendar invite. Agenda: confirm redline priorities, walk PO field mapping, agree on temporary PO validation limits.
